in_marathi.name: Arohi
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Moving towards the goal
in_marathi.long_meaning: Arohi हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Arohi is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘arh’ which means ‘to reach’ or ‘goal’. The suffix ‘hi’ in Arohi means ‘moving towards’. This name is used to describe someone who is always moving towards their goal, determined and focused.
